headline: Google ends free cellular safety features on older Pixel Watches
summary: Google is ending free Safety Signal cellular access on LTE versions of the Pixel Watch 2 and 3, which enabled features like Emergency SOS and Fall Detection without a carrier plan; access ends by December.

claims.statement: Google is ending free Safety Signal cellular access for LTE Pixel Watch 2 and 3 models.

sources.quote: the LTE versions of the Pixel Watch 2 and 3 are losing free access to Safety Signal

claims.statement: Safety Signal allowed features like Emergency SOS, Fall Detection, and Safety Check over cellular without a carrier plan.

sources.quote: features like Emergency SOS, Fall Detection, and Safety Check to work through cellular networks without the need for a carrier plan

claims.statement: Access to the feature will end by December.

sources.quote: Access to the emergency feature for LTE-connected wearables will end by December.
